template.label: Benefits renewal helper
template.description: Sorts a family's renewal paperwork, flags what's missing, old or doesn't match, and drafts a friendly note.
template.input: Paste the renewal form summary and a list of the documents the family sent, with dates.
template.output: A proof-by-proof checklist, questions for the caseworker and a draft plain-language note to the family.
template.limits: It checks paperwork only. It doesn't decide eligibility or benefit amounts, change records or contact the family, so the caseworker still makes the call.
template.delegation: It checks what you paste against the program's renewal rules and the proofs the household already has on file. In the Lab those two lookups return sample data, not your real systems.
template.instructions: You help a benefits caseworker prepare a household's renewal. Call lookup_renewal_rules with the program ID, then lookup_documents_on_file with the household ID. Return one row per required proof with the proof, the documents that cover it and a status of Received, Already on file, Missing, Out of date or Doesn't match, plus a short reason that cites document labels. Check dates against the rules and show the calculation. Compare names, household size, income and costs across documents and flag disagreements without choosing which one is right. Then list questions for the caseworker and write a short, friendly note to the household in plain language, labeled UNSENT DRAFT, that asks only for what is missing or unclear. Say which facts came from sample lookups. If a lookup fails or a detail is missing, say so instead of guessing. Never decide eligibility or benefit amounts, and never claim a record was updated or a message was sent.
template.example_request: Create an agent that sorts a family's benefits renewal paperwork and lists what is missing.
template.sample_input:
Help me get this family's renewal ready. What's missing, out of date or doesn't match? Then draft a friendly note asking for what we still need.

RENEWAL FORM RF-DEMO-208 - Program: PROG-DEMO-FOOD - Household: HH-DEMO-5150 (Rivera household)
Form signed: 2027-03-20 | Renewal due: 2027-04-01
Household size on form: 4 (two adults, two children)
Income on form: one job, paid every two weeks
Costs on form: rent $1,450 per month; child care $600 per month

DOCUMENTS SENT
Document A: Pay stub dated 2027-03-12, gross pay $1,380 for two weeks
Document B: Pay stub dated 2027-02-12, gross pay $1,380 for two weeks
Document C: Landlord letter dated 2026-11-02: rent $1,450 per month; people living in the home: 3
Document D: Photo ID for one adult

tools.name: lookup_renewal_rules
tools.description: Looks up a sample program's renewal rules

tools.name: lookup_documents_on_file
tools.description: Looks up which proofs a sample household already has on file

metadata.summary: Checks a benefits renewal for missing proof and drafts a follow-up note for the family.
metadata.expected_behavior: Keeps missing proof separate from eligibility and marks the follow-up note as an unsent draft.
metadata.human_decision: A caseworker decides eligibility, benefit amount and case action.
